program_name: Master Universitario en Ingenieria Acustica (Master's in Acoustic Engineering)
degree_awarded: Master Universitario (official title, RUCT-registered - titulo oficial)
institution: Universidad de Malaga (UMA) - E.T.S. Ingenieria de Telecomunicacion
english_level_required: None stated; Spanish B2 required instead
tuition_notes: Master NO habilitante, Grupo 3 (Ingenierias y Arquitectura), 1a matricula = 13,68 EUR/credit. ARITHMETIC: 13,68 x 60 ECTS = 820.80 EUR total. Add one-off admin fees: apertura de expediente 59,10 + tarjeta identidad 5,70 = 64,80. Master title issue 176,00 on graduation. UMA IS THE ONE EXCEPTION that publishes an art.3.2 clause: its master fee annex applies the tariffs 'con caracter provisional a los estudiantes de nacionalidad extranjera ... que no tengan la condicion de residente -temporal o de larga duracion- en Espana O LA AUTORIZACION DE ESTANCIA POR ESTUDIOS', with a complementary charge of up to 100% of real cost if proof is not filed by 1 November. CRUCIALLY - and unlike Madrid Decreto 43/2022 art.8, where a student-stay permit does NOT count as residence - the student-stay authorisation EXPLICITLY COUNTS at UMA. A Tunisian on a Spanish student visa satisfies it and pays the standard rate; the only real risk is missing the 1 November document deadline. NO non-EU surcharge applies. Andalusian Decreto 98/2023 (BOJA 84, 05/05/2023) Anexo I apdo.1. Column heading verbatim: 'Precio segun la vez de matricula / 1.a 2.a 3.a 4.a y ss.' - bands are keyed ONLY to enrolment attempt and experimentality group; NO column is keyed to nationality or residence. Art.3.1-3.2 is the only nationality article: non-EEA/Swiss students pay 'los precios previstos en este decreto'; art.3.2 merely PERMITS a university to vary the credit price for NON-RESIDENT foreigners (cap 100% of cost of service). Decreto 142/2025 (BOJA 172, 08/09/2025) amends only arts.5/6/12/14/DF1 and Anexo I apdo.2 (administrative fees) - it leaves art.3 and the per-credit table untouched, so these rates stand for 2026/27.

RUCT 4312714, 60 ECTS, 1 year. Client's 300-ECTS 5-year diploma vastly exceeds any entry bar. Total tuition ~821 EUR + ~65 EUR admin.

fit_notes: PATH N. THE STRONGEST FUNDING-FIRST ROW IN THIS SLICE, WITH ONE LANGUAGE CAVEAT. Cost is effectively zero: no tuition for any nationality, only ~EUR 360.45 per semester (~EUR 1,442 for the whole 4-semester degree), at two of Berlin's best institutions. Against Berklee Valencia's USD 52,830 for one year or Leiden's EUR 45,000 for two, this row is in a different universe financially. ADMISSION: the requirement text names both "computer science" and "engineering" among qualifying first degrees, with no ECTS quota - the client's 5-year, 300-ECTS software-engineering diploma qualifies outright and well exceeds the "first university degree that qualifies for professional work" bar, so accepts_engineering_bachelor = yes_explicit. program_name: Master en Aprendizaje Profundo para Inteligencia Artificial de Audio y Visual (Master in Deep Learning for Audio and Visual Artificial Intelligence) - renamed; formerly Aprendizaje Profundo para el Tratamiento de Senales de Audio y Video / MUDLAVSP
degree_awarded: Master Universitario oficial, research-oriented (Escuela Politecnica Superior, UAM)
institution: Universidad Autonoma de Madrid (UAM) - Escuela Politecnica Superior
language_of_instruction: English ('Idioma de imparticion: Ingles'; 'the official language for all courses is English')
english_level_required: B2 minimum, evidenced by certificate. Non-native speakers without a certificate may instead be interviewed by the Master's Academic Committee to establish the level - a materially cheaper and faster route than IELTS. UAM publishes a table of accepted language certificates.
tuition_notes: Official UAM programme page, 'Tuition fees (first enrolment)': '2.736 EUR; EXTRACOMUNITARIOS NO RESIDENTES: 5.079 EUR'. The EUR 5,079 line is the figure that applies to this client. WHY: under Decreto 43/2022 de la Comunidad de Madrid (art. 8), Madrid public universities charge non-EU applicants who are not legally resident in Spain the THIRD-ENROLMENT credit price rather than the first-enrolment price, and a student-stay authorisation (estancia por estudios) does NOT count as residence for this purpose. Arithmetic check on UAM's own figures: EUR 5,079 / 60 ECTS = EUR 84.65 per credit, against EUR 2,736 / 60 = EUR 45.60 per credit at the ordinary first-enrolment rate - a factor of 1.86, consistent with the Madrid third-enrolment band (UCM publishes EUR 84.07/credit for the same band). Do NOT use the EUR 2,736 headline for this client. Even so, EUR 5,079 for a full 60-ECTS English-taught master is among the cheapest in scope. tuition_notes: ARITHMETIC from the official UPM public-price table (Decreto 43/2022, Comunidad de Madrid), which publishes a SEPARATE COLUMN headed "Estudiantes Extracomunitarios (*)". MUIA is not named in Anexo I, so it falls under "Resto de masteres": non-EU rate = EUR 84.07 per credit x 60 ECTS = EUR 5,044.20 for a full year. The page states this total verbatim: "Un curso completo (60 ECTS) en primera matricula: 5.044,20 EUR". RATE BASIS - IMPORTANT: the EUR 84.07 non-EU figure is NOT the first-enrolment price. The Spanish/EU first-enrolment price for this band is EUR 45.02/credit (EUR 2,701.20/yr). Under Decreto 43/2022 (Comunidad de Madrid) art. 8, non-EU non-residents are charged the THIRD/FOURTH-enrolment credit price instead, and UPM's own second table confirms the mechanism: for "Resto de masteres oficiales" the columns read Segunda matricula EUR 71.88, Tercera EUR 84.07, Cuarta EUR 84.07, and "Estudiantes Extracomunitarios (*) - Todas las matriculas" EUR 84.07. So the client pays the top-of-scale rate from day one, for every enrolment, i.e. 1.87x the EU first-enrolment price - EUR 5,044.20 rather than EUR 2,701.20. Quoting the first-enrolment price here would understate the real cost by 87%. The decreto's footnote confirms a student stay authorisation does not confer residence: "(*) Nota: A estos efectos, la autorizacion de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 1155/2024..." - so the client cannot fall into the Tipo 1 / resident band. DO NOT GENERALISE THIS PER-CREDIT FIGURE ACROSS SPAIN: the surcharge MECHANISM differs by region. Madrid applies the third/fourth-enrolment rate (this row and URJC AD-065). Valencia instead doubles the base rate - UPV publishes EUR 35.34 (Tipo 1) vs EUR 70.68 (Tipo 2) per credit, giving EUR 4,240.80 for 60 ECTS on rows C-079 and G-094. The two mechanisms happen to land near each other here but are not the same rule. Add EUR 250 place-reservation deposit (deducted from tuition afterwards, non-refundable if you do not enrol). Payment can be single or split into eight instalments.

entry_requirements_summary: Verbatim: 'At least a bachelor's degree from a recognised Dutch research university with a good overall result or an equivalent qualification from an international higher education institution.' PLUS 'SOME TRAINING IN ECONOMICS AT UNIVERSITY LEVEL, combined with a sustained interest in arts and culture documented in academic studies and/or vocational experience'; PLUS 'ACADEMIC TRAINING IN EMPIRICAL RESEARCH METHODS'; PLUS 'a well-documented interest in the cultural sector, as indicated by courses taken or practical experience'. No discipline list and no ECTS quota - the gates are economics coursework, research methods and evidenced cultural-sector engagement. Additional criteria weighed in admission: motivation for the programme, CV, average grade, international background. Documents (all PDF): bachelor's diploma (or apply conditionally), official English translation if the original is not in Dutch, English, German, FRENCH, Italian or Spanish, most recent full transcript with the same translation rule, average grade, proof of English, and a CV in English. BRIDGING ROUTE: 'Promising candidates who do not meet all entry requirements can apply for the one-year PRE-MASTER ARTS AND CULTURE STUDIES', which has a Cultural Economics and Entrepreneurship specialisation, runs ONE YEAR / 45 EC (occasionally two), covers sociology, heritage studies, economics, cultural theory and the globalisation of culture, ends in a bachelor thesis, and gives DIRECT ACCESS to the master on successful completion. It awards a certificate of admission, not a diploma.
scholarship_names: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship. EUR also names Fulbright (American students only), the LPDP Scholarship and StuNed (Indonesian students only) - none of which is open to a Tunisian - and directs students to the Dutch government, their home university, business sponsorship, local government, international organisations (Rotary, UN, World Bank) and NWO.

RETAINED AND CONFIRMED: ENTRY RISK - university-level ECONOMICS coursework, empirical research methods training and documented cultural-sector engagement are all required; a software-engineering diploma supplies the research-methods and quantitative half but may not supply the economics or the cultural-sector half, which is why this stays 'unclear' rather than 'likely'. fit_notes: BEST EUR ENTRY ROUTE FOR THIS CLIENT of the three ESHCC options: unlike Media & Business or Media & Creative Industries it does NOT enumerate eligible disciplines - it asks for economics training plus empirical research methods plus documented interest in arts and culture. A 5-year Tunisian engineering diploma normally carries economie/gestion and statistics modules; if the transcript shows them, this becomes 'likely'. THE CLIENT SHOULD AUDIT HIS TRANSCRIPT FOR ECONOMICS CREDITS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE - that single check decides whether this is a direct-entry or a two-year row. The music-production portfolio and DJ activity are exactly the kind of 'sustained interest in arts and culture documented in ... vocational experience' the page asks for, so the cultural-sector half is satisfiable without further study. BRIDGING ROUTE NOW CONFIRMED AND SHORT: the one-year, 45-EC Pre-master Arts and Culture Studies has a Cultural Economics and Entrepreneurship specialisation and gives DIRECT ACCESS to the master on completion - so a September 2027 pre-master plus a September 2028 master is a viable fallback if the economics gate is not met. Practical advantage for a Tunisian applicant: EUR accepts diplomas and transcripts in FRENCH without translation. Heavy overlap with Path L (entrepreneurship) - the orchestrator should dedupe against L. Cost remains the weak point at EUR 21,000 unfunded for one year, roughly triple the UB Barcelona cultural-management route (row L-132) for a comparable subject.
